title: Arcane Egg
description: At the end of a long platforming sequence filled with spikes. _An artefact almost impossibly old, marked inside with many fine etchings. Most are indecipherable._ _"...No will... No self... Shade..."_

title: Bone Scroll
description: Held by a corpse found when swimming all the way to the right in the [secret room.](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478666) _Faded parchment containing the last words of a lost pilgrim._ _"-ter I die here in the damp dark than join those poor sods, trapped to stumble, aimless and empty, until their limbs fall to dust."_

title: Bone Scroll
description: Required: [Drifter's Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477971) _Signed parchment containing a pilgrim’s scrawl._ _"My dear companions, all are gone now, devoured, scorched, fallen to exhaustion, or even worse seduced by the Haunting."_

title: Bone Scroll
description: At the end of a tunnel behind the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478552). _Filthy rag, marked with the scrawl of an Underworker._ _"So much suffering. Are we truly chosen, or have we sinned unknowing, and now are punished for it?"_

title: Bone Scroll
description: At the very top of a platforming challenge. You'll need a fair bit of silk! Crumpled parchment containing the prayer of a Burning Bug. "Hail to your heat! O glorious flame. You who builds and breaks us. Sear our shells. Char them black. That we may rise to join you, wreathed in bright and blazing joy."

title: Choral Commandment
description: On a high-up ledge. _Decree of the Citadel, dirty and worn._ _"Full Chamber to the kingdom of the White Wyrm. Claim the Weaver, in half part. Last of their line. Sensed strong with Silk._ _Resistance anticipated. Quell with rune cage."_

title: Choral Commandment
description: _Surgeon's orders._ _"Devout has succumbed during Silk suture. Refuses to revive. Sin committed. Permit no rites._ _Husk marked for cremation. Retrieve dregs."_

title: Choral Commandment
description: At the end of a room above the [Hidden Passage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480039), easiest to reach via [Silk Soar](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479288). _Tattered decree of the Citadel._ _"Bug of voice grown hoarse or shell fallen frail, you have been selected for duty most sacred._ _Become our light, our guide in darkness, that others worthy may climb to join the holy song"_

title: Choral Commandment
description: Required: Complete [The Lost Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479244) Wish Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 180 Rosaries _Last edict of the Conductors._ _"And lo, is eternity sustained. By Architect's claw, we welcome that final form, of dial and rotor, and soul gladly given._ _The perfect, unfaltering voice."_

title: Mask Shard

title: Mask Shard
description: Required: [Silk Soar](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479288), or: - [Swift Step](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477915) from the platform in the first screenshot above - [Clawline](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478714) immediately after - [Faydown Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479103) to gain a bit more height

title: Mask Shard

title: Mask Shard

title: Mask Shard

title: Mask Shard
description: Required: [Clawline](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478714) and [Drifter's Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477971) At the top of the [Skull Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477968), not initially accessible. Must traverse to the bottom, trigger an explosion and fight several waves of small enemies. After the final wave, the lava starts to erupt and you must parkour back to the entrance. The lava creates an updraft to reach your reward. CAUTION: Near the top of the parkour, there is a path to the right and the left. The left leads to the entrance. Don't get trapped in the right-hand path.

title: Mask Shard
description: At the end of a precarious series of corridors, filled with [Slubberlug](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478965) and parasite-infested waters. Required: [Clawline](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478714)

title: Hunter's Memento
description: Required: Complete the [Hunter's Journal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478043) _Note: The journal entries for [Shakra](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479822), [Garmond & Zaza](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479361), [Palestag](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480321), [Lost Garmond](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480325), [Lost Lace](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480341) and [Summoned Saviour](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480310) are not required._

title: Guardian's Memento
description: [ACT 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260) Required: - Beat [Shrine Guardian Seth](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479401) - Find [Seth in Greymoor](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479407) - Find [Seth in Shellwood](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479640) - Find [Seth in Grand Gate](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480277) - Find [Seth in Fleatopia](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479641) - Beat Seth's high scores in all minigames in caravan games. - Score higher than 55 in Juggle - Score higher than 90 in Dodge - Score higher than 68 in Bounce - Talk to [Seth in Fleatopia](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479641)

title: Psalm Cylinder - High Halls
description: In the room behind the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480051). To reach it, climb onto the platform at the leftmost side and [Clawline](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478714) your way into the tunnels. Continue to the right and wall-jump up to find it at the bottom of a tunnel at the far end.

title: Psalm Cylinder - Underworks
description: At the end of a corridor behind the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480044). _#2 - Last surgery of Conductor Mizello_

title: Rune Harp
description: On a high-up ledge. _Words of a Weaver from the nest beneath Bone Bottom._ _"Hide her deep, the despised child, our shame shown in shell of iron. She is a wish cast vain, divinity mimicked in form too frail."_

title: Rune Harp
description: At the end of the path beneath the [Passage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479055). Equip [Silkspeed Anklets](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478216) and drink [Flea Brew](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478025), then run through the room above to reach it. _Plea of a Weaver from the furthest edge of Pharloom._ _"Flee, sisters. Flee until your strength exhausts, so far you may escape at last her silken sight._ _To start anew, to sustain, free of web and service eternal."_

title: Rune Harp
description: Where Conductor Ballador would be in Act 3. _Last words of the Weavers._ _"Sisters, spiders, the burden is passed. These simple bugs shall bear it full. Never to cease. Never to Silence_ _We shall die, and wait, and pray, that one may come of silken strength enough to weave us free."_

title: Weaver Effigy
description: In a secret room that's easiest to reach when using the [Drifter's Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477971) and floating down from above. _Carving of Camora, Weaver of healing. A prayer is etched upon it._ _"Weaver, heal my sons, their fearful hearts, their limbs that shake at the clumb to come. We pray, gift but a glimmer of your strength, that when we stand before your divinity, you see bugs shed free of fear"_

title: Weaver Effigy
description: Required: [Cling Grip](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478189) _Carving of Keelal, Weaver of the path. How great your mind to care so much for ones so lowly."_

title: Weaver Effigy
description: Held by a corpse at the end of the upper path. _Carving of Atla, Weaver of time. A prayer is etched upon it._ _"By grace of your example, and our history held full in mind, our song is yours, as your name is sacred. Weaver Atla, may you be praised eternal."_

description: Can be purchased from [Forge Daughter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476912) for 110 Rosaries, 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) Effect: Reduces the damage taken from flame and magma

title: Warding Bell
description: Effect: Shield while healing

title: Weighted Belt
description: Can be purchased from [Mort](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477946) for 160 Rosaries Effect: Gives you more time to recover after taking damage and reduces knockback

title: Flintslate
description: Effect: Sharpening slate made from cut and polished Flintgem. Temporarily super-heats the needle's blade, imbuing each slash with flame and increasing leathality.

title: Flea Brew
description: Complete [The Lost Fleas](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477857) Wish and talk to [Grishkin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478023) Effect: Temporarily increases the speed of movement and attacks

title: Threefold Pin
description: In the [Secret Room](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478651), entered by walking through the wall. Effect: Set of throwing blades

title: Longpin
description: In a secret room behind a Wood Wasp nest. Effect: Pierces tough shells

title: Silkspeed Anklets
description: Required: [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199), [Swift Step](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477915) - dash across the room to reveal it. Effect: Increases sprinting speed, consumes Silk

title: Druid's Eye
description: Required: Complete [Berry Picking](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477876) Wish Effect: Upon taking damage, silk is formed Can be upgraded to [Druid's Eyes](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480493).

title: Pollip Pouch
description: Required: Complete [Rite of the Pollip](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478173) Wish Effect: Applies venom to equipped Tools

title: Barbed Bracelet
description: Effect: Increases damage taken, but also increases damage dealt by the needle

title: Multibinder
description: Required: Complete [My Missing Courier](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478207) Can be purchased from [Frey](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478203) for 880 Rosaries Effect: Extends the act of binding, but increases its healing effect

title: Tacks
description: Required: Complete [Roach Guts](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478356) Wish Effect: Leaves spikes on the ground, damaging enemies that step on them. _Note: In Act 3, it will appear on the floor inside the hut._

title: Plasmium Phial
description: Complete [Alchemist's Assistant](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478482) Wish Effect: Grants a temporary health boost that disappears upon sitting on a bench, just like Lifeblood _Tip: With the [Architect Crest](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478745), this can be used to get 9 Plasmium Masks at once which triggers Plasmium Overdose, a state wherein you get passive health regeneration, granting essentially infinite health. This resets after dying, sitting on a bench, and fast traveling._

title: Thief's Mark
description: Sold by [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 350 Rosaries Effect: Enemies drop more Rosaries, but you lose some Rosaries when taking damage

title: Delver's Drill
description: Effect: Downward drill attack. Deals heavy damage.

title: Curveclaw
description: Sold by [Mottled Skarr](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478602) for 140 Rosaries Effect: Throwing weapon In Act 3, it can be found [here](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479726).

title: Fractured Mask
description: Sold by [Mottled Skarr](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478602) for 260 Rosaries, or found on the ground here later in the game. Effect: Shields against critical damage, but shatters on impact. Repaired by resting at a bench.

title: Claw Mirror
description: Required: Defeat [Trobbio](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478690) Effect: Emits a flash that damages surrounding enemies

title: Cogwork Wheel
description: Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 360 Rosaries and 1 Craftmetal Effect: Throws a buzzsaw on the ground which can climb walls and loop back around, potentially hitting an enemy multiple times

title: Sawtooth Circlet
description: Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 230 Rosaries and 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) Effect: Using the Drifter's Cloak or Faydown Cloak damages surrounding enemies

title: Scuttlebrace
description: Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 140 Rosaries and 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) Effect: Dodge backwards

title: Silkshot (Twelfth Architect)
description: Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 130 Rosaries + 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) + [Ruined Tool](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478457) Effect: Triple projectile attack, uses Shell Shards and Silk

title: Quick Sling
description: In a secret area above two [Breakable Ceilings](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478847). Effect: Throws tools twice with a single use (uses twice as much ammo)

title: Ascendant's Grip
description: Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 350 Rosaries Effect: Cling to walls indefinitely

title: Spool Extender
description: Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 720 Rosaries Effect: Allows the storing of additional Silk

title: Cogfly
description: Required: 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) Effect: Winged cogwork companion that will seek nearby enemies and attack

title: Rosary Cannon
description: Behind a breakable wall in the [Rosary Storage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478911) - Simple Key required Effect: Shoots rosaries

title: Memory Crystal
description: Inside a large shard of ice at the end of a tunnel. Effect: When you take damage, leave an ice clone behind that shoots out spikes when hit by an enemy.

title: Pimpillo
description: Interact with the table. Required: [Cling Grip](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478189), [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) (x1) Effect: Grenade. Explodes on impact or a few seconds after throwing.

title: Weavelight
description: Inside a decoration on the ceiling of the rooftop where you fight [Moss Mother x2](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478440) Effect: Increases the speed of Silk regeneration.

title: Snare Setter
description: [Silk and Soul](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479243) Wish Required: [Faydown Cloak](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479103) Effect: Landmine

title: Dead Bug's Purse
description: Held by a corpse in a small room guarded by 2 Gromlings. Effect: Retain some rosaries upon defeat. Play the needolin here for more lore.

title: Voltvessels
description: Effect: When thrown, forms an electrical orb

title: Wreath of Purity
description: Effect: Repel Muckmaggots and maggot-based attacks for ~6.5 seconds before breaking. Can be repaired at a bench.

title: Wispfire Lantern
description: Required: Defeat [Father of the Flame](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479155) Effect: Uses a slight amount of silk to spawn wisps that attack enemies

title: Injector Band
description: Effect: Increases the speed of binding

title: Snitch Pick
description: Sold by [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 740 Rosaries Effect: Harpoon into enemies to get Rosaries and Shell Shards

title: Volt Filament
description: Required: Defeat [Voltvyrm](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479223) Effect: Electric charge on Silk Skills

title: Conchcutter
description: Found almost immediately after entering the Coral Tower. Effect: Throwable weapon, can also ricochet from surfaces

title: Longclaw
description: Required: Complete [Broodfeast](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478865) Wish Effect: Increases the range of needle

title: Throwing Ring
description: Required: Complete [Trail's End](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479237) Wish Effect: Rebounds between enemies and hard surfaces

title: Spider Strings
description: Required: Complete [The Lost Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479244) Wish Can be purchased from [Jubilana](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478877) for 320 Rosaries Effect: Expands the range of the [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199), and makes Needolin dialogue / lore appear and cycle faster.

title: Reserve Bind
description: Required: Defeat [Second Sentinel](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479253) Effect: Holds a Bind's worth of silk that can be used even when out of silk. Refills at benches.

title: Magnetite Dice
description: Required: Beat [Lumble The Lucky](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478519) at dice enough times, or return to this spot after visiting the Choral Chambers. Effect: Chance to negate an attack Note: Can also be bought from [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 300 Rosaries in [ACT 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260)

title: Silkshot (Forge Daughter)
description: Purchased from [Forge Daughter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476912) for 240 Rosaries + 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) + [Ruined Tool](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478457). May be unavailable after defeating [Forebrothers Signis & Gron](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478831). Effect: Burst projectile attack

title: Dark Mirror / Claw Mirrors
description: Required: Defeat [Tormented Trobbio](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479377) Upgraded version of the [Claw Mirror](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478691). Not required for 100% completion. Effect: While binding, emits a more powerful blast that damages surrounding enemies

title: Egg of Flealia
description: Find every Lost Flea in Pharloom Effect: Decreases the cost of Silk Skills while health is full

title: Pin Badge
description: Required: Defeat [Pinstress](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479464) in Act 3 Effect: Reduces charge time of Needle Strike

title: Silkshot (Weaver)
description: Bring the [Ruined Tool](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478457) and 1 [Craftmetal](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/guides/craftmetal) to the table near the [Bench](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478382) to create it. Effect: Uses shell canisters and the wielder's own Silk to fire.

title: Shell Satchel
description: Steel Soul mode only! Effect: Increases the quantity of crafted tools.

title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
description: Can be purchased from [Forge Daughter](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476912) for 180 Rosaries Effect: Increases tool damage _Fully upgrading your crafting kit is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Tool Pouch Upgrade
description: Can be purchased from [Mort](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477946) for 220 Rosaries Effect: Increases the capacity for Tools and Shell Shards that can be carried _Fully upgrading your tool pouch is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Crest of Hunter Upgrade 1
description: Required: Speak to [Eva](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478228) and allow the Insight. Effect: Hitting enemies generates Focus. Fill the focus bar to deal more damage. Slots: - 2 Red - 2 Blue - 2 Yellow

title: Tool Pouch Upgrade
description: Complete [Loddie's](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478251) first challenge by hitting the target 15 times, or find it here in [Act 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260). Effect: Increases the capacity for Tools and Shell Shards that can be carried _Fully upgrading your tool pouch is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
description: Complete [Crawbug Clearing](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478208) Wish Effect: Increases tool damage _Fully upgrading your crafting kit is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
description: Sold by [Grindle](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478522) for 700 Rosaries Effect: Increases tool damage _Fully upgrading your crafting kit is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Crafting Kit Upgrade
description: Purchased from [Twelfth Architect](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478723) for 450 Rosaries Effect: Increases tool damage _Fully upgrading your crafting kit is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Vesticrest
description: Required: Unlock a total of 12 tool slots via Memory Lockets and acquiring new Crests, then talk to [Eva](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478228). _Note: Silk Skill slots count towards the total, but unlocking slots on the Hunter crest does not._ Effect: +1 Yellow tool slot on all Crests

title: Tool Pouch Upgrade
description: Complete [Bugs of Pharloom](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478042) Wish Effect: Increases the capacity for Tools and Shell Shards that can be carried _Fully upgrading your tool pouch is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Vesticrest Upgrade
description: Required: Unlock a total of 20 tool slots via Memory Lockets and acquiring new Crests, then talk to [Eva](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478228). _Note: Silk Skill slots count towards the total, but unlocking slots on the Hunter crest does not._ Effect: +1 Blue tool slot on all Crests

title: Tool Pouch Upgrade
description: Find 20 Lost Fleas in Pharloom Effect: Increases the capacity for Tools and Shell Shards that can be carried _Fully upgrading your tool pouch is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Crest of Hunter Upgrade 2
description: Required: Unlock a total of 27 tool slots via Memory Lockets and acquiring new Crests, then talk to [Eva](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478228). _Note: Silk Skill slots count towards the total, but unlocking slots on the Hunter crest does not._ Effect: Focus bar gets bigger; fill it to deal even more damage. Slots: - 2 Red - 2 Blue - 2 Yellow

title: Curvesickle
description: Act 3 Required: [Curveclaw](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478604) - hit each of the four targets with one thrown Curveclaw, then give the Curveclaw to the Skarr Rogue that appears. Upon resting at a bench and returning to the area, the Curvesickle will be waiting for you. Effect: Throwing weapon with a boomerang effect. Acts as a permanent upgrade to the Curveclaw _This upgrade is not a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Druid's Eyes
description: Deliver four extra Mossberries to the Druid for an upgrade to the [Druid's Eye](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478255). Effect: Upon taking damage, more silk is formed _This upgrade is not a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Weapon Upgrades
description: Unlocked by [Pinmaster Plinney](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478210). Needle Upgrades: - Sharpened Needle - Speak to Plinney after defeating [Widow](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478138) - Shining Needle - Complete the [Pinmaster's Oil](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478211) Wish - Hivesteel Needle - Complete the [Great Taste of Pharloom](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478889) Wish and hand over 450 Rosaries - Pale Steel Needle - Complete the [Ecstasy of the End](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479444) Wish and hand over 680 Rosaries _Fully upgrading your weapon is a requirement for 100% completion._

title: Arena Battle
description: In a room only accessible once you've unlocked the [Cling Grip](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478189). Enemies: - 2x Beastfly + 1x Smelt Shoveller - 1x Flintstone Flyer + 1x Pilgrim Hulk - 2x Beastfly - 1x Beastfly + 1x Flintstone Flyer + 1x Smokerock Sifter - 4x Beastfly

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 1x Skarr Stalker - 2x Skarrwing - 1x Skarr Scout, 1x Spear Skarr - 2x Skarr Scout - 1x Spear Skarr, 1x Skarr Stalker In Act 3: - 1x Skarr Scout + 1x Skarr Stalker - 2x Spear Skarr - 1x Spear Skarr + 1x Skarr Stalker

title: Arena Battle
description: Inside the building. Enemies: - 1 Squatcraw + 1 Craw - 2 Craw - 1 Tallcraw + 1 Craw - 3 Craw - 1 Squatcraw + 1 Tallcraw

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - Skarr Scout x1 - Skarrlid x2 - Skarrwing x2 - Skarr Scout x1 + Skarrwing x1

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 1x Smelt Shoveller + 1x Flintstone Flyer - 1x Smokerock Sifter - 2x Flintstone Flyer - 1x Flintstone Flyer + 1x Smokerock Sifter - 1x Smelt Shoveller + 1x Smokerock Sifter

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 1x Underworker, 1x Underloft - 1x Underworker, 1x Underloft, 1x Undersweep - 1x Underloft, 1x Undercrank - 1x Undercrank (breaks floor and dies) - 1x Underloft, 1x Underpoke

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 1x Undercrank + 1x Underloft - 1x Undercrank + 1x Underpoke _Tip: Kill the first Undercrank with tools before you get locked in for an easier fight!_

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 1x Filntstone Flyer, 1x Smelt Shoveller, 1x Smokerock Sifter - 1x Flintflame Flyer - 1x Deep Diver, 1x Smokerock Sifter, 1x Flintstone Flyer - 2x Flintflame Flyer

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - x2 Verdanir - x1 Escalion + x1 Kindanir - x1 Kindanir + x1 Escalion

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 1x Choristor, 1x Reed, 1x Envoy - 2x Choristor - 1x Choir Bellbearer, 1x Reed - 2x Minister - 2x Maestro - 1x Choir Clapper - 1x Choir Bellbearer, 2x Reed - 2x Choir Bellbearer, 1x Choristor - 1x Choir Bellbearer, 2x Minister - 1x Maestro, 1x Reed - 2x Choir Clapper

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - Choir Hornhead x1 + Choir Flyer x1 + Choristor x1 - Choir Hornhead x1 + Choir Elder x1 + Choir Pouncer x1 - Choir Flyer x1 + Reed x1 + Choir Bellbearer x1 - Choristor x1 + Choir Pouncer x1 + Choir Flyer x1 + Choir Bellbearer x1 - Vaultkeeper x1

title: Arena Battle
description: In a room entered from above. Enemies: - Beastfly x1 - Skull Scuttler x2 - Beastfly x2 - Skull Brute x1

title: Court of Craws
description: Required: Open the [Craw's Door](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479575)

title: Arena Battle
description: - 1x Skarrgard + 1x Spear Skarr

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 1 Choristor, 1 Reed - 1 Choir Flyer, 1 Choir Pouncer, 1 Clawmaiden - 1 Choristor, 1 Choir Bellbearer - 2 Reed, 1 Clawmaiden (after 1 Reed defeated)

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 2x Dreg Catcher - 1x Thread Raker During Act 3: - 2x Dreg Catcher - 1x Dreg Catcher + 1x Roachcatcher - 2x Thread Raker

title: Arena Battle
description: Inside the [Chapel of the Reaper](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478155). Enemies: - Silk Snipper x1 - Dreg Catcher x2 - Thread Raker x1 - Silk Snipper x2

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 2x Phacia - 1x Splinterhorn + 1x Splinter - 1x Splinterhorn + 1x Splinter + 1x Phacia

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - Cogwork Choirbug x2 - Cogwork Spine x3 + Cogwork Cleanser x1 - Cogworker x2 - Cogwork Choirbug x1 + Cogwork Defender x1 - Cogworker x2 - Cogwork Defender x1

title: Arena Battle
description: Begins when you open the [Passage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=480024). Enemies: - 1x Underscrub + 1x Undersweep - 2x Cogwork Hauler - 1x Underloft + 1x Underpoke - 1x Cogwork Hauler - 1x Undercrank - 2x Cogwork Hauler

title: Arena Battle
description: Before fighting [The Unravelled](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478926), you'll need to face: - 1x Dreg Husk - 1x Dreg Husk + 1x Dregwheel

title: Arena Battle
description: Begins as you approach the [memory locket.](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478246) Enemies: - 1x Elder Pilgrim - 1x Winged Pilgrim + 1x Pilgrim Groveller - 1x Pilgrim Groveller + 1x Pilgrim Pouncer

title: Arena Battle
description: In the basement of the [Chapel of the Wanderer](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478239). Enemies: - 1x Pilgrim Pouncer + 1x Pilgrim Groveller + 1x Winged Pilgrim - 1x Winged Pilgrim + 1x Pilgrim Hulk - 1x Pilgrim Hornfly + 1x Pilgrim Guide - 1x Pilgrim Hornfly +1x Pilgrim Hulk + 1x Winged Pilgrim

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 2x Stilkin - 2x Stilkin Trapper - 3x Swamp Squit - 1x Stilkin Trapper + 1x Stilkin - 2x Swamp Squit + 1x Stilkin Trapper - [Groal The Great](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478861)

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - 2x Cogwork Clapper

title: Arena Battle
description: Begins when you find [Sherma](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479179) during the [Balm for The Wounded](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478933) Wish. Enemies: - 1x Surgeon - 2x Mortician - 2x Surgeon

title: Arena Battle
description: Enemies: - Scabfly - Guardfly

title: Arena Battle
description: [ACT 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479260) Enemies: - 1x Underpoke, 1x Underworker - 1x Undercrank, 1x Underloft

title: Arena Battle
description: A second Arena Battle begins in this room after pulling a [Lever](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479824) in the room below. Enemies: - 4x Vaultborn - 4x Vaultborn - 2x Vaultkeeper

title: Arena Battle
description: May only be available if you were sent to The Slab in a cage. Enemies: - 1x Guardfly - 1x Wardenfly - 1x Guardfly + 2x Scabfly - 4x Scabfly - 1x Guardfly + 1x Wardenfly _Fun fact: The music that plays during this boss fight is Hornet's boss theme from Hollow Knight!_

title: Moss Mother
description: Reward: - None

title: Lace
description: Reward: - [Pharloom's Welcome](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478311) Warning: This fight and its achievement are missable if you go to Blasted Steps or Sinner's Road via the Wormways, or move the Flea Caravan to Greymoor without fighting Lace here first.

title: Creepy Surprise
description: Before killing [Widow](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478138), quit the game (or just return to the main menu) after resting on the [Bench](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=476884) in the middle of Bellhart. When you resume playing, Hornet will be dangling from a web like the rest of the townsfolk.

title: A Hard Day's Work
description: Run on the treadmill next to [Loam](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478562) for some time to receive a generous salary, courtesy of the Citadel - one rosary bead!

title: Parasite... Good?
description: If you're captured by a cage-carrying Wardenfly while [cursed](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478792), you won't be sent to the [usual spot](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478462). Instead, the parasite will lash out, setting Hornet free and killing the would-be kidnapper.

title: Free Quill!
description: If you avoid purchasing a quill from [Shakra](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=477852), a unique red one can be collected here, near [Trobbio](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478690)'s boss room - though defeating him is not a requirement. Similarly, a unique purple quill can be found here in Act 3. The quill you collect will determine the icon of the Map & Quill in the inventory screen.

title: Hope for Verdania
description: Some time after defeating the [Clover Dancers](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479427), greenery will begin to sprout from their final resting places. It may take time, but it seems there's hope for the old kingdom yet.

title: Lore Tablet
description: Take a right when you reach the bottom of the elevator, climb the ledges, and hit a lever to reach it. _At the seventh bell toll, send:_ _Thirty measures, four beats Smokerock,_ _Eight beats Sweetsmelt,_ _Mark of fealty, all workers._ _At the ninth bell toll, send:_ _Twenty measures, two beats Smokerock,_ _Seven beats Sweetsmelt,_ _Mark of fealty, all workers._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _In the air. The water. Everywhere._ _Inside their shells. Twisted inside. Guts._ _Tightest around heart. Pulsing rhythm._ _Sick. Alive. Dead?_ _Something worse._ _Deeper. Must look deeper._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _-ilgrim_ _You who have held tight to faith have been carried far._ _This station shall offer brief rest to those devout._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Pilgrim_ _This settlement welcomes all who step the holy path._ _May you ease your shell within, that your strength renewed can carry you higher._

title: Lore
description: _Litany of the Worker_ _May we catch the dregs and never tire,_ _May we clean the dregs and never hunger,_ _May we spool the dregs and never falter._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Pilgrim_ _This settlement welcomes all who step the holy path._ _May you ease your shell within, that your strength renewed can carry you higher._

title: Lore
description: _This low, her gaze escaped._ _Prepare, sisters. Weave hope anew._ _That we might break free this accursed web born of our naive foundation._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Pilgrim_ _You are blessed to walk the foundations of Pharloom._ _Humble yourself before the shells of those who gave their lives to hold our kingdom's weight._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Weaver of Pharloom._ _By grace you warded. By thread you healed._ _For your favour, eternal, we offer our song._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _On the eighth harvest, send:_ _Fifty measures, nine beats dregthread, spooled,_ _Fourteen measures dregthread, twined,_ _Oath of fealty, all workers._ _On the twelfth harvest, send:_ _Forty measures dregthread, spooled,_ _Two beats fine thread, twined,_ _Oath of fealty, all workers._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Pilgrim_ _Spare a song for those who lay here silent._ _By strength abandoned they fell before the final ascent._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Pilgrim_ _Accept the judgement of the rise beyond,_ _That all who stand at Pharloom's holy crest prove pure of will and want._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Sister, spider, sat between salt and stone,_ _Build those tools of brilliant mind imagined,_ _Aid us when our Silk has waned._

title: Needolin Lore
description: Use the [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199) to see the final thoughts of Alchemist Zylotol's first assistant. _The buds must grow..._ _Only a little... Only a spark..._ _To our dead lands... life..._ _Too dark..._

title: Lore Tablet
description: In a room behind the [Breakable Wall](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478534) _Bug born of Pharloom. You have been chosen._ _May our Citadel's holy gilding harden your soft shell._ _Stand eternal as our arbiter, that no bug bearing sin shall step within our sacred halls._

title: Confession Stand
description: Insert 25 Rosaries for lore. On the other side, attack some gears to break the machine and receive different dialogue. _Speak now. Thy confession will be heard._ _Hornet: ..._ _You have confessed a sin most grave and must by works cleanse yourself._ _Return to your task and work off-cycle, neither eating nor supping until new-cycle begins._ _By the grace of Pharloom eternal may you never tire. Toil, and be forgiven._ --- Alternative dialogue if the machine is broken on the other side: _Speak... ... confession..._ _Hornet: ..._ _You... ... sin... ... cleanse..._ _Return... ... work... ... begins...._ _... Pharloom... ... never... ... forgiven._

title: Lore
description: _Great bugs! You who weep as your kingdom fades, join me upon the Stage._ _Together, we shall enflame the passion of Pharloom!_

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Here is established, by holy consent of the Conductors, The Memorium of Pharloom._ _What Is Remembered Is Never Lost._

title: Lore
description: _O, great land whose flame doth falter!_ _Whose choir, conductors, all doth fail,_ _Observe! Take heart! That spark still burning,_ _Yon butterfly of crimson grace,_ _All bells shall peal, and voices raise,_ _When brave Trobbio steps, at last, upon the stage!_

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Hate for their light. Hate for their pins. For their waste poured thick and endless._ _Fill your hearts with hate, for power has now been claimed, and with it we shall punish._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Oath of the Whiteward_ _While song must be sung, none may falter._ _Infirmity. Sickness. Death._ _All are banished from our Citadel._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Sister, spider, if seeking commune with the creature atop this mount, take the climb above as a test, a challenge beyond even our setting._ _Upon that summit gained, and creature hailed, know it shall choose what gift to grant, with death as likely as insight._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Their shells are ours. Their souls are ours._ _Our hate is forever._

title: Lore
description: _Penitent, Eight of the Twelfth._ _Guilty of the sin of irreverence._ _Penance by chaining._ _Absolution granted after death._ _Penitent, Second of the Fourth._ _Guilty of the sin of dissonance._ _Penance by silencing._ _Absolution granted after death._

title: Lore
description: _Penitent, Fourth of the Fourth._ _Guilty of the sins of infirmity, sickness._ _Penance by swallowing._ _Absolution granted after death._ _Penitent, Twelfth of the First._ _Guilty of an unnamed sin._ _Penance by casting._ _Absolution not granted._

title: Lore
description: Note: Will disappear after breaking all of the bindings outside the cell. _Penitent, First of the First._ _Guilty of the sin of apostasy._ _Penance by constriction._ _Absolution denied._

title: Lore
description: At the end of the path beneath the [Passage](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479055). _A rune depicting paths away from Pharloom._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Due to unacceptably high injury and unsanctioned deaths, Ventrica travel shall henceforth be denied to all._ _For Pharloom eternal, a bug who serves must never die._

title: Lore
description: _Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, frail with age._ _Tracked and taken in Sandsea Waste._ _Seven Choristors, nine Envoys lost to task._

title: Lore
description: _Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, mortally wounded._ _Tracked and taken in the Blackbarrens._ _Four Choristors, one Reed lost to task._

title: Lore
description: _Weaver, in quarter part, last of their line, staked to service._ _Tracked and taken beneath the City of Steel._ _Eight Choristors, twelve Envoys lost to task._

title: Lore Tablet
description: _Containment fails. Memory lost. Excise outer. Maintain inner._ _Shellwood stasis sustained - Remember._ _Marrowlands stasis critical - Remember._ _Verdanian environment exceeded - Destined to forget._

title: Riddle Tablet
description: Required: [Silk Soar](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479288) to reach it Locations of Herald the Mushroom: - [Mister Mushroom 1](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479146) - "Under chapel fallen to the monarch's might" - [Mister Mushroom 2](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479362) - "Over camp collapsed to the black thread plight" - [Mister Mushroom 3](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479312) - "Scorched field on edge, shells black and burned" - [Mister Mushroom 4](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479315) - "Up towers spinning, near the surgeon spurned" - [Mister Mushroom 5](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479311) - "Cage of one who raged against the silken lie" - [Mister Mushroom 6](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479314) - "Fell heart of frost, who soars on high" - [Mister Mushroom 7](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479330) - "Past cradle's peak, last test of fitness"

title: Needolin Lore
description: Required: [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199). Must be read before the Flea Caravan will move here. _Sisters, spiders, watch these waters flow,_ _Cleansing Binding, as Silk from shell,_ _Memories of our kingdom calm._

title: Lore
description: _Coral sways,_ _Clear water flows,_ _Upon our river free of time._

title: Lore
description: _At water's source,_ _And coral's heart,_ _Our lord born last to rule._

title: Lore
description: _Flickering Flame_ _Five masks swirled soul, brought and broiled._ _Four stones rage-baked, crushed powder coarse._ _Three shells fresh from pilgrims fallen, to contain and age._

title: Lore
description: Adds [Void Tendrils](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=479744) to the Hunter's Journal. _A rune-scroll depicting void given form._

title: Lore
description: _Erase our fear,_ _Eliminate our desire,_ _To suffer no more,_ _Void, cleanse us._

title: Lore
description: _In silence your voice,_ _In darkness your form,_ _We higher who see you seeking,_ _Our shells yearn for your embrace._

title: Needolin Lore
description: Lore revealed by playing [Needolin](https://mapgenie.io/hollow-knight-silksong/maps/pharloom?locationIds=478199) _Sister, spider, husk bound to branch,_ _Watch over these bugs, passing safe,_ _Warded by fear,_ _No longer your meal._

title: Lore
description: ACT 3 _Damned are we! The lingered few bound still to suffer. Cursed thrice by Pharloom, to wait, to watch, to cry our anguish._ _No more! We say! No more! We cry! We all have wailed and wept. Fair Pharloom's fall has come at last. Its end we now accept._

title: Lore
